cds2526.title: University of Montana Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF; the posted file contains only sections A and B)

stats.notes: Admissions figures are the 2024-25 CDS (fall 2024 entering class): C1 applied 9,464, admitted 9,048, enrolled 1,652. UM's posted 2025-26 CDS contains only sections A and B (no admissions data), so fall 2025 admission counts are not available. The 2024-25 CDS residency table (in-state/out-of-state/international) is blank, so intl_applicants and intl_admits are null. Undergraduate enrollment (7,874) and nonresident-alien undergraduates (64, total undergraduates, B2) are from the 2025-26 CDS (fall 2025); student-faculty ratio is fall 2024 (17.9 to 1). SAT/ACT submitted percentages are for enrolled first-year students. No early decision or early action.
